mapper.sql: where ec.status = '0' and (ec.certification_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sv.version_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and sv.certification_id = #{certificationId} and sv.version_name ilike concat(#{versionName}, '%') and exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point status_kp where status_kp.syllabus_version_id = sv.id and status_kp.del_flag = '0') and not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point status_kp where status_kp.syllabus_version_id = sv.id and status_kp.del_flag = '0')
mapper.select:
with filtered_syllabuses as ( select sv.id, sv.certification_id, sv.version_name, sv.published_date, sv.update_time, ec.certification_name, ec.sort_order from cm_syllabus_version sv join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = sv.certification_id
), knowledge_counts as ( select kp.syllabus_version_id, count(*) as knowledge_point_count from cm_knowledge_point kp join filtered_syllabuses fs on fs.id = kp.syllabus_version_id where kp.del_flag = '0' group by kp.syllabus_version_id ), latest_imports as ( select distinct on (ib.syllabus_version_id) ib.syllabus_version_id, ib.finished_time from cm_import_batch ib join filtered_syllabuses fs on fs.id = ib.syllabus_version_id where ib.import_type = 'knowledge_point' and ib.status = 'completed' order by ib.syllabus_version_id, ib.finished_time desc nulls last, ib.id desc ) select cast(fs.id as varchar) as id, fs.certification_name as display_name, cast(fs.certification_id as varchar) as certification_id, fs.certification_name, fs.version_name, fs.published_date, fs.update_time, li.finished_time as latest_knowledge_import_time, coalesce(kc.knowledge_point_count, 0) as knowledge_point_count, case when coalesce(kc.knowledge_point_count, 0) > 0 then 'available' else 'empty' end as status from filtered_syllabuses fs left join knowledge_counts kc on kc.syllabus_version_id = fs.id left join latest_imports li on li.syllabus_version_id = fs.id order by fs.sort_order, fs.published_date desc nulls last, fs.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from cm_syllabus_version sv join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = sv.certification_id

select cast(sv.id as varchar) as id, cast(sv.certification_id as varchar) as certification_id, ec.certification_name, sv.version_name, sv.published_date, sv.create_time as created_time from cm_syllabus_version sv join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = sv.certification_id and ec.status = '0' where sv.id = #{syllabusVersionId}

select cast(ib.id as varchar) as batch_id, ib.finished_time, ib.source_file_name, ib.generated_count from cm_import_batch ib where ib.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and ib.import_type = 'knowledge_point' and ib.status = 'completed' order by ib.finished_time desc nulls last, ib.id desc limit 1

select 1 as syllabus_version_record_count, (select count(*) from cm_exam_subject es where es.certification_id = sv.certification_id)::int as subject_count, count(kp.id) as knowledge_point_count, count(kp.id) filter (where exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id = kp.id and child.syllabus_version_id = kp.syllabus_version_id and child.exam_subject_id = kp.exam_subject_id and child.del_flag = '0')) as directory_count, count(kp.id) filter (where not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id = kp.id and child.syllabus_version_id = kp.syllabus_version_id and child.exam_subject_id = kp.exam_subject_id and child.del_flag = '0')) as leaf_count from cm_syllabus_version sv left join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.syllabus_version_id = sv.id and kp.del_flag = '0' where sv.id = #{syllabusVersionId} group by sv.id, sv.certification_id

select cast(es.id as varchar) as id, es.subject_code, es.subject_name, row_number() over (order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, es.id)::int as sort_order, count(kp.id) as knowledge_point_count from cm_exam_subject es join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.certification_id = es.certification_id left join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.syllabus_version_id = sv.id and kp.exam_subject_id = es.id and kp.del_flag = '0' where sv.id = #{syllabusVersionId} group by es.id, es.subject_code, es.subject_name order by sort_order

select cast(kp.id as varchar) as id, cast(kp.parent_id as varchar) as parent_id, cast(kp.exam_subject_id as varchar) as exam_subject_id, es.subject_code as exam_subject_code, kp.syllabus_number, kp.syllabus_title, kp.tree_depth, kp.sort_order, kp.importance, kp.diagnostic_enabled, kp.recommendation_enabled, kp.status, exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id = kp.id and child.syllabus_version_id = kp.syllabus_version_id and child.exam_subject_id = kp.exam_subject_id and child.del_flag = '0') as has_children, kp.create_time as created_time, kp.update_time as updated_time from cm_knowledge_point kp join cm_exam_subject es on es.id = kp.exam_subject_id where kp.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and kp.del_flag = '0' order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, kp.tree_depth, kp.parent_id nulls first, kp.sort_order, kp.syllabus_number, kp.id
select id from cm_syllabus_version where id = #{syllabusVersionId} for update
select payload_hash, status, resource_id, response_status, cast(response_body as text) response_body from cm_idempotency_record where action_code = #{action} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status = 'succeeded', resource_id = #{resourceId}, response_status = 200, response_body = cast(#{responseBody} as jsonb), update_time = now() where action_code = #{action} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: select set_config('certmuse.qualification_cascade_delete', case when #{enabled} then 'on' else 'off' end, true)

select distinct storage_path from ( select image.storage_path from cm_document_image image join cm_document_chunk chunk on chunk.id = image.chunk_id join cm_document document on document.id = chunk.document_id where document.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} union select image.storage_path from cm_question_image image join cm_question_revision revision on revision.id = image.question_revision_id where revision.question_id in ( select distinct question.id from cm_question question join cm_question_knowledge relation on relation.question_id = question.id join cm_knowledge_point knowledge_point on knowledge_point.id = relation.knowledge_point_id where knowledge_point.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} and not exists ( select 1 from cm_question_knowledge other_relation join cm_knowledge_point other_knowledge_point on other_knowledge_point.id = other_relation.knowledge_point_id where other_relation.question_id = question.id and other_knowledge_point.syllabus_version_id <> #{syllabusVersionId} ) ) ) storage_objects where coalesce(trim(storage_path), '') <> ''
mapper.delete: delete from cm_question question where exists ( select 1 from cm_question_knowledge relation join cm_knowledge_point knowledge_point on knowledge_point.id = relation.knowledge_point_id where relation.question_id = question.id and knowledge_point.syllabus_version_id = #{syllabusVersionId} ) and not exists ( select 1 from cm_question_knowledge other_relation join cm_knowledge_point other_knowledge_point on other_knowledge_point.id = other_relation.knowledge_point_id where other_relation.question_id = question.id and other_knowledge_point.syllabus_version_id <> #{syllabusVersionId} )
